label: Research direction
title: Research: the question, where the work stands, and what would justify more
summary: Everything completed through 2026-10-08 is integrated. September closed the application lines for want of a consumer; October returned to the mathematics of the commutator itself with the jet, its hidden fibres and an exact bound on repairing Rule 110's parity-plus-Groovy observer. No empirical unit is queued.
takeaway: Three candidates are listed, each needing a decision argument first: autonomous and lossy jets, a symmetry account of hidden fibres, and a full-line version of the latent-Q bound. The page is kept short; units report in their own notes and the findings.

label: Research boundaries
title: What we can prove, what we cannot infer, and where this project contributes
summary: A map of locality, finite-state decidability, classification limits, universality, coarse-graining and predictive equivalence, with primary sources and explicit repository implications.
takeaway: Unbounded impossibility results constrain particular questions; exact factors, obstructions and representation costs remain actionable.

title: Held structures: partial results and a stream-timing correction
summary: The 2,112-row ninth unit is integrated with every frozen prediction accounted for. P4a/P4c/P4d are invalidated by an off-by-one input stream; a bounded diagnostic reproduces the defect and repairs three witnesses.
